incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD Incident ID: PD-8249. Alert: downstream-queue-length > 12000 (hotpath). Automatic page to eng-oncall.

pagerduty: Incident PD-8249: acknowledged by maria.

maria: acked — I'm on it. seeing huge queue backlog on hotpath regional cluster (us-west-2).

devon: joining. any customer-facing errors?

maria: 502s up ~4%, p95 latency x2 on requests that hit model-runtime queues. throughput steady but backlog growing. likely autoscaler not reacting; scale metrics show nodes at 93% and cores at limit.

jules: paging logs from autoscaler show repeated failed scale attempts: "resource quota exceeded" and kube API 429.

samir: copying kube logs: ```
E0315 12:01:03.124  kube-controller-manager autoscaler.go:452] scale up failed: quotaExceeded: nodeGroup quota reached
W0315 12:01:03.125  autoscaler: backoff window 30s
```

maria: good call. it looks like cloud provider quota throttling. need immediate mitigation to avoid customer impact. options: 1) manual scale within existing node groups if quota allows, 2) spin up a short-lived burst node group in a different AZ/region, 3) drop lower-priority traffic via rate-limiter.

devon: I'm going to route non-critical traffic to degraded path (model-approx) for now. adding a route rule.

devon: `/deploy-routing set-route --service hotpath --rule deprioritize=background --weight 0.1` (running)

ops-runner: route change applied, background traffic now 10% to hotpath, majority routed to model-approx.

maria: that should relieve some incoming load. simultaneously, I'll try manual scale for the autoscaler target group (+4 nodes) — if quota blocks, we'll request burst capacity.

maria: running: ```
kubectl scale --replicas=8 deploy/hotpath-worker -n inference
```

jules: kube API still returning 429 for new node creation. cloud console shows account hit regional node quota.

samir: I can request quota increase but that'll take ~15-30 min. not fast enough. we need short-term OS-level mitigations.

devon: cache flush? If we flush prefix KV cache, we might reduce queue head churn if stale keys block the runtime. risk: initial spike.

maria: not great. I propose: A) keep degraded routing in place, B) temporarily increase batching window to lower per-request CPU (config change), C) continue trying cross-AZ burst node group.

maria: applying batching tweak: ```
PATCH /v1/configs/hotpath
{"batching": {"max_wait_ms": 60, "max_tokens": 2048}}
```

ops-runner: batching tweak accepted. monitoring effect.

pagerduty: PD-8249 status updated: acknowledged by maria, notifying escalation policy primary->secondary at +10min.

devon: monitoring: queue length dropped 22% after routing + batching. errors trending down. p95 still elevated.

jules: we're still seeing occasional job stalls related to KV cache eviction churn. I recommend we rotate the worker pods to force fresh cache warmup on a subset, not all at once.

maria: doing a rolling restart with maxUnavailable=1 to limit impact: ```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/hotpath-worker -n inference --max-unavailable=1
```

samir: rolling restart started. watching for cold-warm jank.

devon: customer impact summary for PD ticket: "Partial degradation in request latency for hotpath customers in us-west-2; ~12% of model requests experienced elevated errors/latency window between 12:00-12:20 UTC. No data leakage. Some production requests rerouted to model-approx fallback."

maria: confirm: customer impact communicated to oncall@ and severity set to SEV2.

ops-runner: rolling restart progressed 3/8, no increase in errors so far. queue length down another 15%.

jules: autoscaler still failing scale attempts due to quota. ops has submitted quota request for us-west-2, request ID Q-9082.

maria: if quota not available quickly, next step is to enable cross-region fallback for a small percent. I'm going to prep runbook steps for that and handoff to next oncall.

devon: agree. mitigation reduced impact to acceptable levels; keeping PD ticket open until autoscaler healthy.

incident-bot: PD-8249 will auto-escalate in 9 minutes if status not updated.

maria: I'll document current state and hand off to jules for longer-term follow-through. jules, next actions: monitor quota request, validate autoscaler restart after quota change, run postmortem owning the root-cause (quota + autoscaler backoff).

jules: taking postmortem ownership. will prepare a short incident report and tag infra/quota in follow-up.

samir: note for postmortem: consider implementing pre-warm quota checks in autoscaler and a fallback to a lower-cost eviction policy to avoid full stall.

maria: handing over to jules — I'm marking incident as under mitigation. Next oncall (tomorrow) please pick up any remaining follow-ups.

devon: thx all. I'll keep an eye on metrics for next 30m. please ping if it regresses. :thumbsup:

jules: updating PD notes and closing active mitigations. timeline will be added to the PD ticket.

pagerduty: PD-8249: status updated -> under investigation (mitigating).

maria: final note before handoff: playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-quota-fallback. add that to the incident doc.

jules: copied — will attach. closing handoff now.

samir: ack.

maria: thanks team.

(End of thread)
